items.title: Banco Bradesco (BOVESPA:BBDC4) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Analysts Turn More Cautious
items.summary: The fair value estimate for Banco Bradesco has been reset from R$22.25 to R$20.00, which now lines up with the updated price target range on the stock. This shift mirrors more cautious analyst views, with several firms moving to Neutral or Market Perform ratings and clustering their targets between R$16 and R$20.
